pages.title: Transuranic Synthesis
pages.text: $(thing)Transuranic Synthesis$()$(br2)Beyond uranium every element is made: a nucleus is fed neutrons until it beta-decays up the table - plutonium, americium, curium, californium. Unlocks Californium-252.
$(thing)Insight$(): 160$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Nuclear Fission, Accelerator Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Plutonium-239 Pellet, 4 Uranium-238 Pellet.
